---
title: "F-saPAKE — Strong asymmetric PAKE"
status: "Canonical"
layer: 3
---

*F-saPAKE* (Strong asymmetric PAKE) is part of *Public-Key Primitives, Key Exchange, Messaging* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

Introduced in the same paper as *F-aPAKE*, as part of the OPAQUE asymmetric PAKE protocol.

*References:*

- Jarecki, Krawczyk, and Xu. [*OPAQUE: An asymmetric PAKE protocol secure against pre-computation attacks*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2018/163). In Advances in Cryptology – EUROCRYPT 2018, volume 10822 of LNCS, pages 456–486, 2018.
